portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Silver Nova — Silversea's newest ultra-luxury ship — departs on a 7-night all-inclusive Alaska voyage for 728 discerning guests.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A day of pure luxury cruising through the Inside Passage. All beverages, all restaurants, and all activities are included in your fare. Silversea's Venetian Society hosts an enrichment lecture on Alaska's natural history.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's scenic capital with complimentary shore excursion options included in your Silversea fare. Helicopter glacier tours and whale watching are among the most popular selections for Silver Nova guests.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway is the highlight of Skagway — and for Silversea guests, select excursion credits make exploring Alaska's iconic Gold Rush town effortlessly enjoyable.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: A full day of scenic cruising through Glacier Bay with Silversea's naturalist expedition team on board to narrate the remarkable glacial landscape. A transcendent Alaska experience.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Silversea's Alaska itineraries consistently include Sitka — a port that rewards cultured travelers with its blend of Tlingit heritage, Russian colonial history, and outstanding sea otter sightings.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: Return to Seattle — disembarkation day after a magnificent 7-night ultra-luxury Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

reviewSnippet: "Silver Nova is the pinnacle of Alaska cruising. Every meal, every drink, every excursion — all included, and all extraordinary. Seeing Glacier Bay from the observation deck of this intimate ship with a glass of Champagne in hand is a memory for a lifetime." — Verified Guest
